subject: My script get stacked at ggplot2 plot commands

messages.author: 612ccd78449ca899
messages.subject: My script get stacked at ggplot2 plot commands
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

Sorry if my questions is obvious but I'm very new with R and ggplot also.
I'm using MS Windows7 / RStudio version 0.97.551 / R version 2.15.3 (2013-03-01) including package ‘ggplot2’ version 0.9.3.1
With my script I obtain 4 plots using base package plot commands. Before to start each one of them I use:
plot.new() 
close.screen () 
and everything works fine.
At the end of the script there are the following lines:

...
#####5th Plot ######
plot.new() 
close.screen () 

vSMN <- rep(c("SMN"),each=12)  # Creates vector SMN
vAWS <- rep(c("AWS"), each=12) # Creates vector AWS
vSMNAWS <- append (vSMN,vAWS)  # Appends vectors SMN and AWS

monthly_means_SMNAWS <- append (monthly_means_SMN,monthly_means_AWS)
monthly_sds_SMNAWS <- append (monthly_sds_SMN, monthly_sds_AWS)
TicksMonths2 <- append (1:12, 1:12)
limits <- aes(ymax = monthly_means_SMNAWS   monthly_sds_SMNAWS, 
              ymin=monthly_means_SMNAWS - monthly_sds_SMNAWS)

df <- data.frame (monthly_means_SMNAWS, monthly_sds_SMNAWS, 
                  month= factor(c(TicksMonths2)), sta= factor(c(vSMNAWS)))

# pp <- ggplot(df, aes (sta, monthly_means_SMNAWS)) 

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes (colour=sta, sta, monthly_means_SMNAWS))  
  facet_grid(. ~ month)   geom_point(aes(colour= sta), size = 3.5)
p1   geom_point(aes(colour= sta), size = 3.5)  geom_errorbar(limits, width=0.25)   
  scale_color_manual(values=c(rgb(255, 0, 0, maxColorValue = 255), rgb(0, 0, 255, maxColorValue = 255)))
p1


and the script get stacked, but if I run line by line the aforementioned code, it works good and I can obtain the attached plot.
Please, can someone explain me why the script get stacked at the last piece of code (5th Plot).
Thank you very in advance.

Hernán
